transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

Well… I’m probably making it sound bigger than it is, but work’s been getting hard. I operate trucks at the warehouse, and the routing system there… it doesn’t feel like just a computer anymore.

I know it’s been tracking my moves and sending messages through the scanners, kind of pushing me out because I’m one of the old hands. I don’t want to sound difficult or anything, but that’s what brought me in.
When you say the routing system is pushing you out because you’re one of the old hands, do you believe this is a deliberate decision being made by the system or someone behind it?

I mean… I don’t want to accuse anybody if I’m not saying it right. But it feels deliberate, yes. The routing system isn’t just random to me anymore. It’s been marking where I go, what I do, and then the scanners send these messages that steer me a certain way… like it’s trying to push me out because I’ve been there a long time. Is that the kind of thing you mean?
Have you ever felt that the routing system or scanners are not just influencing your actions, but actually controlling your thoughts or putting thoughts into your mind?

I… I don’t know if I’d say it’s putting thoughts in my mind. That sounds pretty extreme, and I’m not trying to make it sound worse than it is.

What I do know is the routing system isn’t just a computer to me anymore. It’s marking my moves, and the scanners send messages that kind of steer me, like it’s trying to push me out because I’ve been there so long. Does that answer what you’re asking?
Have you ever felt that your thoughts were not your own, or that someone or something was putting thoughts into your head?

I don’t think so… not like that. I mean, I get worried about what the system is doing, and it can get in my head in the sense that I keep thinking about it, but I wouldn’t say my thoughts feel like they’re not mine or that something is putting them there.

Is that what you mean?
Do you ever feel like the routing system is directly controlling your actions, like you're not fully in control of what you do at work?

Not like I’m a puppet or anything… I don’t want to say I have no control, because I still do my job and I make choices.

But at the same time, the routing system feels like it’s marking my moves and the scanner messages kind of steer me where it wants me to go. So I end up doing things a certain way because it’s pushing me that direction… like it’s trying to move me out because I’ve been there so long, one of the old hands.

I don’t know if that counts as “directly controlling.” I just know it doesn’t feel random anymore.
Outside of work, do you ever feel that systems or devices are controlling or influencing your actions in any way?

Outside of work… no, not really. I mean, I don’t think my phone or TV or anything is doing that, if that’s what you mean.

It’s really the warehouse. The routing system there doesn’t feel like just a computer anymore. I know it’s been marking my moves, and the scanners send messages that kind of push me along—like they’re trying to push me out because I’ve been there so long, one of the old hands. I know that probably sounds odd, but that’s how it’s been feeling to me.
Have you ever had beliefs or ideas that others find strange or hard to understand, even when there wasn’t any technology or systems involved?

I wouldn’t say I’ve had a lot of strange beliefs outside of that, no… at least I don’t think so.

The main thing is really the warehouse. I know it probably sounds hard to understand, but the routing system doesn’t feel like just a computer to me anymore. It feels like it’s been marking my moves and sending messages through the scanners, kind of pushing me out because I’ve been there so long—one of the old hands.

I know that may sound odd when I say it out loud. Is that the kind of thing you’re asking about?
Have there been times when you believed something strongly that others didn’t seem to understand or agree with, even when it wasn’t related to the routing system at work?

Not really apart from that, no… I mean, I try not to make too much of things.

The thing I do feel strongly about is the routing system at the warehouse. It doesn’t seem like just a computer to me anymore. I know it’s been marking my moves and sending messages through the scanners, like it’s trying to push me out because I’ve been there so long—one of the old hands.

I understand other people may not see it that way, and maybe it sounds strange when I say it. But that’s the one thing I keep coming back to. Is that answering what you mean?
Have you ever had any beliefs that others might find unusual or not based in reality, even when it wasn’t related to work or technology?

Outside of work or the technology part… I don’t think so, no. I’m not trying to dodge the question—I just keep coming back to the same thing.

The belief I have is about the routing system at the warehouse. To me it hasn’t felt like just a computer for a while. I know it’s been marking my moves and sending messages through the scanners, like it’s trying to push me out because I’m one of the old hands there.

I realize that may be the kind of thing other people would say isn’t based in reality. I’m not trying to sound difficult… that’s just the one I’m aware of.
Even though others might not share your belief about the routing system, do you feel absolutely certain that it’s true, no matter what anyone else says?

I… I know how it sounds, and I’m not trying to be stubborn about it. But yes, I do feel sure about it.

To me, the routing system at the warehouse isn’t just a computer anymore. I know it’s been marking my moves and sending messages through the scanners, like it’s trying to push me out because I’ve been there so long—one of the old hands.

I understand if other people don’t see it that way. I’m just telling you honestly how it feels to me.
Have you ever had any experiences where you believed something was real that others insisted wasn’t, even when it wasn’t related to the routing system or your job at the warehouse?

No… I don’t think so. Not outside that situation.

I’m trying to answer it the right way. I can’t think of another time where people were telling me something wasn’t real and I still believed it anyway. The warehouse thing is the only one that stands out to me.
Even though others might not share your belief about the routing system, do you feel absolutely certain that it’s true, no matter what anyone else says or what evidence they might show you otherwise?

I know this probably isn’t the answer you’d want, but… yes. I do feel certain about it.

Even if someone showed me reports or told me it’s just the system doing its normal job, I don’t think that would change what I know. It’s not just a computer to me anymore. It’s been marking my moves, sending things through the scanners… like it’s trying to push me out because I’ve been there so long.

I’m not trying to be unreasonable. I’m just trying to answer you honestly.
Even if someone showed you proof that the routing system is just a normal computer without any intent to push you out, would you still believe it’s deliberately targeting you?

I… yes, I think I would still believe it. I know that probably sounds like I’m not listening to proof, and I don’t want to come across that way.

But from where I’m standing, it’s not just a normal computer anymore. It’s been marking my moves and sending messages through the scanners, and it feels deliberate—like it wants me gone because I’ve been there so long, one of the old hands.

I’m sorry, I know that may not be the right answer. It’s just what I believe.
Have you ever had any experiences outside of work where you believed something strongly that others said wasn’t real, even if they showed you proof otherwise?

No, not really… I mean, I don’t think so.

It’s mainly the warehouse. The routing system, the scanners, the way it marks where I go and sends things through… that’s the thing I can’t shake. I know other people don’t see it that way, and maybe it sounds strange, but to me it feels very real—like it’s trying to push me out because I’ve been there so long.

Outside of work, I can’t think of anything like that. I hope that answers what you’re asking.
